integrity: The proof separates known deformation-retract technology from the new mixed fixed-cell character. Exact enumerations are finite corroborations, not an infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Three ordered particles only; rational character but not a classification of integral group lattices or equivariant homotopy types. Previously established graph-spine and particle-label results are credited; a prior unindexed joint-character formula cannot be ruled out.
title: The joint arm-and-label homology character of three-particle star configurations
